content.description: Tangem Wallet is a hardware wallet product built around secure cards, mobile access, and self-custody. Its site describes buying, selling, storing, and managing crypto assets through a simple cold-wallet experience. The listing is relevant to TON because Tangem supports TON asset storage inside a broader hardware-wallet ecosystem. Manage cryptocurrencies securely in the best crypto wallet.
